_meta.description: Explicit curriculum spine - recommended progression through QFEP
_meta.note: v1.3: array_tutorial moved before color; color absorbs composition (sourced from primitive-stack, pattern, and facade galleries). v1.4: reactivated isosurfaces + boolean_surfaces as spine sequences (orders 12.5 and 12.7) on the lambda_edge phase between proceduralgeneration and softbodies.

navigation.description: How the player moves through the game
rules: The Lab is the central hub. All sequences start and end here.
The last map in every sequence returns the player to the Lab.
On return to Lab, new teleporters appear based on completed sequences.
Spine sequences unlock the next spine sequence teleporter.
Branch sequences unlock from their parent (spine or branch).
Branch completions can unlock further branch sequences (chain unlocks).
The player discovers the full curriculum by completing sequences and returning to see what opened.
navigation.teleporter_logic: Defined by branch_points + branch_chains. Spine progression is linear (order field). On completing sequence X, all sequences listed in X's unlocks appear as new Lab teleporters.

spine.description: The recommended path through Ada Research, ordered by QFEP phases

sequences.name: primitives
sequences.qfep_role: Foundation - points, lines, planes, and basic vectors

sequences.name: transformation
sequences.qfep_role: Invariants - dot/cross products enable rotation

sequences.name: array_tutorial
sequences.description: Array fundamentals - grid structures and indexing. Moved before color so its repetition primitives feed the composition vocabulary.
sequences.qfep_role: Foundation - the grid, indexing, addressable repetition

sequences.name: color
sequences.description: Color and composition. Hue/value/saturation lead into pattern, stack, and facade composition (gallery-sourced). Absorbed the standalone composition study.
sequences.qfep_role: Foundation - color systems become composition systems

sequences.name: change
sequences.qfep_role: Foundation - the calculus substrate. Derivative as instantaneous rate, integral as accumulation, vector field as flow. The vocabulary forces / wavefunctions / randomness / noise will all use.
sequences.description: New sequence (2026-05-13) addressing the calculus shadow named in the math-density sieve. Sits between color (4) and forces (5). Status: scaffolded — maps and artifacts as placeholders; build follows.

sequences.name: forces
sequences.qfep_role: Newton's laws - vectors become physics

sequences.name: formfinding
sequences.description: The variational principle — form as the minimum of a functional. Sequence #24, inserted 2026-07-07 after forces (dynamics) and before wavefunctions: forces move things, form-finding is where they come to REST. Cast entirely from the pre-existing gradient-descent / minimal-surface / energy-landscape families.
sequences.qfep_role: Foundation - the F term made physical; free-energy minimization as the shape matter settles into, stopping short of the dead-perfect bottom

sequences.name: wavefunctions
sequences.qfep_role: F ↔ E oscillation - sine creates curves

sequences.name: randomness
sequences.qfep_role: Disorder as creative force

sequences.name: noise
sequences.qfep_role: Structured randomness - Perlin, flow fields

sequences.name: cellularautomata
sequences.qfep_role: Simple rules → complex behavior. Rule 110 is Turing complete — the λ_edge thesis.
sequences.note: Moved from E_entropy to λ_edge in 2026-05-13 sieve. CA's truth (local rules producing global pattern) is the λ_edge claim's clearest statement.

sequences.name: fractals
sequences.qfep_role: Self-similarity, infinite detail

sequences.name: lsystems
sequences.qfep_role: Generative grammars

sequences.name: proceduralgeneration
sequences.qfep_role: WFC, Markov, emergence from rules

sequences.name: softbodies
sequences.qfep_role: Deformable matter, cloth, fluid + Turing morphogenesis. Cloth descends an energy landscape under gravity + spring constraints.
sequences.note: Absorbed morphogenesis (2 maps). Turing's reaction-diffusion as soft matter finding form. 2026-05-13: shifted from 13 to 14; swarm moved earlier into λ_edge.

sequences.name: isosurfaces
sequences.qfep_role: Implicit fields → explicit surfaces. Marching cubes as the bridge from continuous fields to walkable mesh.
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: moved from λ_edge order 12.5 to F_order order 4.6. Geometric construction at depth — no entropy term. Pairs with boolean_surfaces as advanced F_order.

sequences.name: boolean_surfaces
sequences.qfep_role: CSG operations as composition logic — union, intersection, difference of solids.
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: moved from λ_edge order 12.7 to F_order order 4.7. CSG is pure geometric algebra; F_order is its home.

sequences.name: swarmintelligence
sequences.qfep_role: Collective behavior, stigmergy — local rules + memory of rules → emergent global pattern. Swarm's qfep_term is self-declared λ.
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: moved from integration order 14 to λ_edge order 13. Sequence self-declares qfep_term=λ. Joins CA, fractals, lsystems, procgen as 5th color of the edge.

sequences.name: machinelearning
sequences.qfep_role: Learning systems, neural networks

sequences.name: graphtheory
sequences.qfep_role: Connections define structure. The substrate that was always under it all — every cell, force, agent, neuron was a node; every adjacency, attraction, message, weight was an edge.
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: moved from integration order 19 (terminal) to relation hinge order 16, between integration and synthesis. Repositioned as retroactive substrate recognition — the player meets graphs after seeing every prior system was secretly a graph.

sequences.name: foundationscrisis
sequences.qfep_role: Gödel, Russell - limits of formal systems
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: shifted from 16 to 17 after graphtheory moved up to 16.

sequences.name: qfeplaboratory
sequences.qfep_role: The complete QFEP formula embodied

sequences.name: postfoundationscrisis
sequences.qfep_role: Applied limits — bias, rhizomes, molecular design as post-crisis practice
sequences.note: 2026-05-13: shifted from 18 to 19 — now spine-terminal. Collects real maps from deferred sequences (criticalalgorithms, speculativecomputation, advancedlaboratory). 5 of 8 maps still SCAFFOLD-only; phase 2 build queued.

F_order.name: Order (F)
F_order.description: Free energy minimization - prediction, stability, structure
F_order.truth: What is form, before it moves? A point, a line, a triangle, a cube. Then transformation, array, color, change as time-derivative, isosurfaces extracting form from a field, booleans composing form from form. Seven steps to a vocabulary of deterministic shape.

oscillation.name: Oscillation (F ↔ E)
oscillation.description: Dynamic balance between order and entropy
oscillation.truth: Things that move under rules can run smooth or run wild. Sine is the rule's most ordered output; chaos is its least. The phase oscillates between them — your job is to feel when.

E_entropy.name: Entropy (E(S))
E_entropy.description: System entropy - disorder as creative force
E_entropy.truth: Disorder is a creative force. First, pure: any state equally possible. Then, structured: disorder that remembers continuity. Two sequences; both teach how possibility shapes.

lambda_edge.name: Edge of Chaos (λ)
lambda_edge.description: The λ parameter - tuning between order and chaos
lambda_edge.truth: Where rules and entropy meet, form emerges. CA shows local-rule-makes-global-pattern. Fractals show recursion making infinity. L-systems show grammar making space. Procedural generation shows that an author isn't needed for a world. Swarm shows that no leader is needed for coordination. Five colors of the same edge.

integration.name: Integration (φΔE)
integration.description: Rate of entropy change - emergence, self-organization
integration.truth: Every system you have built so far has been settling. Cloth finds equilibrium under springs. Gradient descent finds minima under loss. Both are landscapes, both descend. Integration is the phase where matter and math do the same thing in different clothes.

relation.name: Relation (substrate)
relation.description: The substrate that was always there — graphs as the universal connection structure
relation.truth: This was always here. Every cell, force, agent, neuron was a node. Every adjacency, attraction, message, weight was an edge. The phase makes the substrate visible.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.description: Full QFEP - edges, paradoxes, queer futures
synthesis.truth: The curriculum is an argument. The crisis says formal systems break. The lab says here is what doesn't break — F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t), a formula that holds chaos as part of itself. The applied phase says now build with that. The edge is not a failure of formalism. The edge is the ground.
